visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a white button-down shirt is seen in a brightly lit sushi restaurant. (2) He holds a red plate featuring a large, rectangular piece of tamagoyaki (egg). He uses chopsticks to take a bite, looking up thoughtfully as he eats. (3) He presents several different sushi plates in sequence, including white fish, red tuna with a green leaf, and cucumber maki rolls. He consumes each piece with a satisfied expression. (4) A larger spread of sushi, fried chicken, and a highball drink appears on the table. He drinks from the glass and continues eating from the variety set. (5) The man reappears in a black sweatshirt and a black baseball cap worn backward. He speaks with exaggerated energy and facial expressions. (6) Multiple plates of salmon sushi are shown in rapid succession through fast jump cuts. He eats them all with high enthusiasm. (7) He sits back, crossing his arms and patting his stomach, appearing very full. (8) He returns to the white shirt outfit, looking into the lens with a wide-eyed, surprised, and slightly confused expression.
